text: to seek for enchantments: Heb. to the meeting of enchantments
whose eyes are open: Heb. who had his eyes shut, but now open
smite the corners of Moab: Or, smite through the princes of Moab
the first of the nations: the nations that warred against Israel, Exodus 17 | shall be, that he perish forever: Or, shall be even to the destruction
the Kenite: Heb. Kain | until Ashur shall carry thee away captive: Or, how long shall it be ere Ashur carry thee away captive
